integrity: The proof expands the minimax polynomial exactly, decomposes off-diagonal entries into direct-edge and two-edge contributions, and gives a matching three-dimensional obstruction for every condition number above three. The packaged standard-library checker independently replays the polynomial algebra and exact witness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the final degree-three Chebyshev polynomial approximation on the exact spectral interval for symmetric positive definite Stieltjes systems. It does not classify higher degrees, intermediate implementation stages, general SPD matrices without the Stieltjes sign pattern, or inaccurate spectral bounds.
title: Condition three is the sharp positivity frontier for the degree-three Chebyshev semi-iterate
